description: This file defines the ModuleTracker class, a context manager for tracking nn.Module hierarchy during execution in PyTorch, including hooks for forward and backward passes.

classes.name: ModuleTracker
classes.description: A context manager class that tracks the hierarchy of nn.Modules during forward and backward passes in PyTorch, providing hooks and state information.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleTracker with default state, including sets for module names and hooks.

methods.name: _maybe_set_engine_callback
methods.description: Queues a callback to reset the parent set during backward pass, if not already set.

methods.name: is_bw
methods.description: Property that indicates if the current execution is during the backward pass.

methods.name: _get_mod_name
methods.description: Recursively retrieves or assigns a name to a module and its children.

methods.name: _get_append_fn
methods.description: Returns a function that adds a module name to the parent set during forward or backward pass.

methods.name: _get_pop_fn
methods.description: Returns a function that removes a module name from the parent set during exit of a module.

methods.name: _fw_pre_hook
methods.description: Hook called before a module's forward pass; updates parent set and registers gradient hooks.

methods.name: _fw_post_hook
methods.description: Hook called after a module's forward pass; updates parent set and registers gradient hooks.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Registers forward pre- and post-hooks for modules.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Removes registered hooks and clears internal state.
